outcome: Creation of a public Unified Health System (SUS)
Decrease in maternal and child mortality
Universal access to prenatal care and hospital delivery
Excessive number of cesareans without clinical indication
cohort: BRISA birth cohort (Ribeirão Preto, State of São Paulo and São Luís, State of Maranhão, northeastern Brazil)
finding: The BRISA birth cohort study documented significant changes in socioeconomic factors, health conditions, and reproductive health in Brazil over four decades.
mod_finding: The study found an increase in Cesarean sections without clinical indication and early-term births.
